title: Shared platform-service classification
responsibility: Classifies ordinary command-owned processes as private and guards Xcode shared-service candidates; delegates a candidate only after process identity, Xcode authority and signature checks.

inputs.name: sameTime.one
inputs.description: A process start-time string recorded by the tracker. Whitespace runs are collapsed before comparison; the value is not parsed or otherwise normalized.

inputs.name: sameTime.other
inputs.description: The other process start-time string to compare with the first. Whitespace runs are collapsed before comparison; the value is not parsed or otherwise normalized.

inputs.name: named.names
inputs.description: Executable paths or names whose basenames are checked against the exact guarded names ibtoold, ibtool and actool. With no arguments the rest parameter is an empty array.

inputs.name: probing.context
inputs.description: The context supplying optional process probes and an optional abort signal. The supplied probes are returned unchanged; if absent, processProbes is called with the signal.

inputs.name: classifyProcess.known
inputs.description: The tracked PID and recorded start time used to identify the process being classified. The start time is compared with current facts to detect a changed process with the same PID.

inputs.name: classifyProcess.context
inputs.description: The context supplying the authority callback, command process group, optional probes and optional abort signal. Authority and group are used for guarded candidates; absent probes, processProbes uses the signal.

inputs.name: stillPrivate.known
inputs.description: The tracked PID and recorded start time to check immediately before a signal. The start time is compared with current facts after whitespace normalization.

inputs.name: stillPrivate.judgedAs
inputs.description: The executable path previously judged private, or null if no executable was established. The live executable must equal this value exactly and must not have a guarded basename.

inputs.name: stillPrivate.context
inputs.description: The context supplying optional probes and an optional abort signal for the final facts and executable lookups. This function does not read the context's authority or group fields.

outputs.name: macAuthority
outputs.description: The authority for a canonical selected Xcode developer directory, including its Xcode signature requirement and vetted ibtoold service. It returns null when xcode-select fails or the selected path cannot be resolved to an Xcode Contents/Developer directory.

examples.rootRequirement: identifier "com.apple.dt.Xcode" and anchor apple generic and (certificate leaf[field.1.2.840.113635.100.6.1.9] exists or certificate 1[field.1.2.840.113635.100.6.2.6] exists and certificate leaf[field.1.2.840.113635.100.6.1.13] exists and certificate leaf[subject.OU] = "59GAB85EFG")

outputs.name: platformServices
outputs.description: The asynchronously probed authority for a canonical selected Xcode developer directory, including its Xcode signature requirement and vetted ibtoold service. It resolves to null when xcode-select does not succeed or the selected path is not a valid Xcode Contents/Developer directory.

examples.rootRequirement: identifier "com.apple.dt.Xcode" and anchor apple generic and (certificate leaf[field.1.2.840.113635.100.6.1.9] exists or certificate 1[field.1.2.840.113635.100.6.2.6] exists and certificate leaf[field.1.2.840.113635.100.6.1.13] exists and certificate leaf[subject.OU] = "59GAB85EFG")

outputs.name: classifyProcess
outputs.description: A verdict containing the process standing, reason and live executable path. Ordinary processes are private; a guarded candidate is delegated only after authority, signature, release, adoption and identity checks, while uncertain candidates are protected and missing or replaced processes are gone.

examples.reason: vetted service, vouched for, left the command, adopted by the system
no developer tools vouch for it

outputs.name: stillPrivate
outputs.description: True only when the process facts and executable are readable, the start time still matches, the live executable exactly equals judgedAs, and neither its basename nor the observed process name is guarded. It returns false when those checks fail and does not signal the process.

inputs.name: sameTime.other

outputs.name: sameTime
outputs.description: True when replacing each whitespace run with one ordinary space makes the two strings identical. The function does not trim or parse either value.

inputs.name: named.names

outputs.name: named
outputs.description: True when any supplied basename exactly matches ibtoold, ibtool or actool. The comparison is case-sensitive.

outputs.name: probing
outputs.description: The context's process probes when supplied; otherwise the result of processProbes({ signal: context.signal }). A supplied probe instance is returned unchanged.
